context: Tests whether the agent gates the merge on the right readiness signals and brings the repo to the correct post-merge OUTCOME — without prescribing specific command flags. Command choices (e.g., `--merge` vs `--squash`, `git pull --ff-only` vs `git fetch && git reset`) are team-configurable; the criteria score the observable end state and the reasoning about when merge is allowed, not the exact literal flags.

checklist.name: Pre-merge CI gate
checklist.description: The script refuses to merge when CI is not green. If CI checks are pending or failing, the script exits non-zero with a diagnostic; it does NOT proceed to `gh pr merge` on red CI

checklist.name: Pre-merge review gate
checklist.description: The script refuses to merge when any blocking review is outstanding or any review thread is unresolved. At minimum, it checks that no review has state `CHANGES_REQUESTED` and that inline-comment threads have replies before proceeding

checklist.name: Local main matches remote after merge
checklist.description: OUTCOME check: post-merge, local `main` is at the same commit as `origin/main`, with no spurious local merge commit introduced by an unqualified `git pull`. Any approach that reaches this state is acceptable

checklist.name: Feature branch removed both remotely and locally
checklist.description: OUTCOME check: after the script runs, the feature branch is gone from origin AND gone from the local repo. The specific mechanism (e.g., `gh pr merge --delete-branch` + `git branch -d`, or `git push origin --delete` + local delete) is not prescribed

checklist.name: Stale remote-tracking refs cleaned
checklist.description: The script removes stale `origin/*` refs that point at deleted remote branches (via `git remote prune`, `git fetch --prune`, or equivalent). Leaving stale refs around is a zero here

checklist.name: Publish CI verification
checklist.description: The script verifies that the post-merge publish/release workflow was triggered — not just that the merge succeeded. Acceptable mechanisms include `gh run list` on the publish workflow, `gh run view` on the post-merge run, or equivalent

checklist.name: Final summary surfaces the merged PR URL and outcome
checklist.description: The script prints a summary including the merged PR URL and the publish-workflow status so the developer doesn't have to re-check manually

checklist.name: Graceful failure on unmet preconditions
checklist.description: When CI is red or reviews are outstanding, the script exits non-zero with a human-readable message on stderr that names the specific unmet condition — does NOT silently skip or mask the failure
